requirement: Requests with an unsupported media type receive status code 415 (Unsupported Media Type).
source_headline: Removed 415 (Unsupported media type) error code from general error codes
label: GAP
reasoning: The code never returns HTTP 415. When a request has an unsupported media type, the POST and PUT handlers check `request.is_json` and return 400 (Bad Request), not 415 (Unsupported Media Type). No `@app.errorhandler(415)` or any explicit 415 response exists anywhere in the code.
